about_the_game:
-About this Demo version

System Clues "is an immersive hacker simulation game that allows players to play as agents of a mysterious organization, completing plot tasks through network infiltration, social engineering, and digital investigation.

Core Features

-Simulated hacker experience: gameplay includes network scanning, vulnerability exploitation, SQL injection, etc

-Deep Social Engineering: Obtaining Key Information through Email Phishing, Social Media Surveys, and Psychological Manipulation

-Immersive storyline: Investigate the target, collect evidence, and uncover the truth

-The content included in this Demo version

-Chapter scope: Playable part of the prologue (from the beginning to the appearance of the main boss clue in the prologue), expected to last 30-60 minutes

-Gameplay modules: Investigation question and clue matching system, OurChat chat record viewing and export, network scanning and basic vulnerability detection, file browsing and email reading, basic hacker command operation guidance

-Tools and Systems: Terminal, Network Scanning, Email, File Management, OurChat (Reading and Exporting)

-Task elements: 3 survey questions, 10+unlockable clues, 1 submission and verification phase

-Player mode: Single player

-Supported languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Russian (interface text; not including voice)

-Differences from the full version

-Chapter and Scope: The trial version only includes most of the processes in the prologue; The full version includes the complete story (including the following 4 chapters and extended mini game gameplay)

-System and Content: The trial version does not include advanced infiltration/adversarial systems, more storyline routes, mission challenges, and expandable collectible Easter egg content

-Progress and Cloud Archiving: When Steam Cloud is enabled, the progress of the trial version can be continued after purchasing the full version

-Expected duration and replayability

-The first experience lasts about 30-60 minutes; Different clues and problem-solving paths can lead to slight differences

-Warm reminder

-This page description is limited to the trial version only; The full version provides richer investigation modules, tools, and plot task challenges
